vocabulary_groups.title: Closures and adjusters
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for visible fastening details and adjustable parts.

items.definition_en: A fastener that opens and closes with interlocking teeth.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The closing part you pull up or down.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte de fechar que voce puxa para cima ou para baixo.
items.example_sentence_en: The zipper is on the front of the jacket.
items.example_sentence_pt: The zipper is on the front of the jacket.
items.professional_context_en: Zipper gives students one clear functional detail for captions and critique.
items.professional_context_pt: Zipper oferece aos alunos um detalhe funcional claro para captions e critica.

items.definition_en: A small fastener attached to a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A small piece used to close a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma pequena peca usada para fechar uma roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: There are buttons on the cuff.
items.example_sentence_pt: There are buttons on the cuff.
items.professional_context_en: Button supports singular and plural detail language.
items.professional_context_pt: Button apoia a linguagem de detalhe no singular e no plural.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to botao or botoes depending on number.

items.definition_en: A cord that can tighten or adjust part of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A string you pull to make the garment tighter.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um cordao que voce puxa para deixar a roupa mais ajustada.
items.example_sentence_en: The drawstring is at the waist.
items.example_sentence_pt: The drawstring is at the waist.
items.professional_context_en: Drawstring connects visible detail language to function and fit.
items.professional_context_pt: Drawstring conecta a linguagem de detalhe visivel a funcao e ajuste.
items.translation_notes_pt: Tie here means a fastening detail, not gravata.

items.definition_en: A hard fastening piece used with a strap or belt.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A strong piece that closes or adjusts a strap.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peca firme que fecha ou ajusta uma tira.
items.example_sentence_en: The buckle is functional and decorative.
items.example_sentence_pt: The buckle is functional and decorative.
items.professional_context_en: Buckle helps students discuss details that can have two roles.
items.professional_context_pt: Buckle ajuda os alunos a discutir detalhes que podem ter duas funcoes.

vocabulary_groups.title: Edges and placement
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for garment edges and simple location language.

items.definition_en: The shape around the neck opening of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The neck opening shape.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O formato da abertura do pescoco.
items.example_sentence_en: The embroidery is near the neckline.
items.example_sentence_pt: The embroidery is near the neckline.
items.professional_context_en: Neckline supports precise location language in design-detail captions.
items.professional_context_pt: Neckline apoia linguagem precisa de localizacao em captions de detalhe.

items.definition_en: The finished lower edge of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The bottom edge of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A borda inferior da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The ruffle is at the hem.
items.example_sentence_pt: The ruffle is at the hem.
items.professional_context_en: Hem is useful in both sewing language and visual-description language.
items.professional_context_pt: Hem e util tanto na linguagem de costura quanto na de descricao visual.

items.definition_en: The band around the waist of a skirt or pants.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The top band at the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A faixa superior na cintura.
items.example_sentence_en: The drawstring is inside the waistband.
items.example_sentence_pt: The drawstring is inside the waistband.
items.professional_context_en: Waistband helps students locate details more precisely than waist alone.
items.professional_context_pt: Waistband ajuda os alunos a localizar detalhes com mais precisao do que apenas waist.

items.definition_en: Close to a place on the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Close to.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Perto de.
items.example_sentence_en: The detail is near the collar.
items.example_sentence_pt: The detail is near the collar.
items.professional_context_en: Near supports short location phrases for A2 writing and speaking.
items.professional_context_pt: Near apoia frases curtas de localizacao para escrita e fala em nivel A2.

vocabulary_groups.title: Pockets and construction
vocabulary_groups.description: Visible practical details and simple construction words.

items.definition_en: A pocket sewn on the outside surface of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A pocket added on the outside.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um bolso costurado do lado de fora.
items.example_sentence_en: There are two patch pockets on the front of the skirt.
items.example_sentence_pt: There are two patch pockets on the front of the skirt.
items.professional_context_en: Patch pocket gives students a visible detail that is easy to identify and explain.
items.professional_context_pt: Patch pocket oferece aos alunos um detalhe visivel facil de identificar e explicar.

items.definition_en: A pocket that is not easy to see from the outside.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A pocket that is not clearly visible.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um bolso que nao e facil de ver por fora.
items.example_sentence_en: The hidden pocket is inside the side seam.
items.example_sentence_pt: The hidden pocket is inside the side seam.
items.professional_context_en: Hidden pocket helps students contrast visible and hidden details.
items.professional_context_pt: Hidden pocket ajuda os alunos a contrastar detalhes visiveis e escondidos.

items.definition_en: Visible stitching on the outside of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Stitching you can see on the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma costura visivel do lado de fora da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The topstitching adds contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: The topstitching adds contrast.
items.professional_context_en: Topstitching connects construction language to visual effect language.
items.professional_context_pt: Topstitching conecta a linguagem de construcao a linguagem de efeito visual.

items.definition_en: One section of a garment that forms part of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: One part or section of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma parte ou secao da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The side panel adds contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: The side panel adds contrast.
items.professional_context_en: Panel supports early patternmaking and garment-description links.
items.professional_context_pt: Panel apoia ligacoes iniciais entre modelagem e descricao da roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: May need recorte or painel depending on context.

vocabulary_groups.title: Decorative details
vocabulary_groups.description: Common visible decorative features for simple caption writing.

items.definition_en: A gathered strip of fabric used as decoration.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A soft gathered fabric detail.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um detalhe de tecido franzido e macio.
items.example_sentence_en: The ruffle makes the garment look playful.
items.example_sentence_pt: The ruffle makes the garment look playful.
items.professional_context_en: Ruffle helps students connect a visible detail to a style effect.
items.professional_context_pt: Ruffle ajuda os alunos a ligar um detalhe visivel a um efeito de estilo.

items.definition_en: A fold in fabric used for shape or decoration.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A folded fabric detail.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um detalhe de tecido dobrado.
items.example_sentence_en: The pleat is at the side of the skirt.
items.example_sentence_pt: The pleat is at the side of the skirt.
items.professional_context_en: Pleat supports both visible-detail reading and early construction language.
items.professional_context_pt: Pleat apoia tanto a leitura de detalhes visiveis quanto a linguagem inicial de construcao.

items.definition_en: Decorative stitching that forms a design on fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Decorative thread design on fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um desenho decorativo feito com linha no tecido.
items.example_sentence_en: The embroidery is near the neckline.
items.example_sentence_pt: The embroidery is near the neckline.
items.professional_context_en: Embroidery gives students one high-contrast decorative detail for reading and listening.
items.professional_context_pt: Embroidery oferece aos alunos um detalhe decorativo de alto contraste para leitura e escuta.

items.definition_en: A decorative or finishing material added to a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Extra material added for finish or decoration.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um material extra usado para acabamento ou decoracao.
items.example_sentence_en: The trim adds contrast at the edge.
items.example_sentence_pt: The trim adds contrast at the edge.
items.professional_context_en: Trim helps students talk about small added details in a general way.
items.professional_context_pt: Trim ajuda os alunos a falar de pequenos detalhes adicionados de forma geral.
items.translation_notes_pt: Can map to acabamento or aviamento depending on context.

vocabulary_groups.title: Function and effect language
vocabulary_groups.description: High-frequency words and phrases for explaining what a detail does or adds.

items.definition_en: Useful for a practical purpose.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Useful in a practical way.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Util de forma pratica.
items.example_sentence_en: The zipper is functional because it opens the jacket.
items.example_sentence_pt: The zipper is functional because it opens the jacket.
items.professional_context_en: Functional is the main concept word for explaining why a detail is useful.
items.professional_context_pt: Functional e a principal palavra de conceito para explicar por que um detalhe e util.

items.definition_en: Added mainly for visual interest or beauty.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Added to make the garment look interesting.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Acrescentado para deixar a roupa mais interessante visualmente.
items.example_sentence_en: The embroidery is decorative because it adds color.
items.example_sentence_pt: The embroidery is decorative because it adds color.
items.professional_context_en: Decorative helps students explain style effect instead of practical use.
items.professional_context_pt: Decorative ajuda os alunos a explicar efeito de estilo em vez de uso pratico.

items.definition_en: Creates a strong visual difference.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Makes one part look clearly different.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Faz uma parte parecer claramente diferente da outra.
items.example_sentence_en: The topstitching adds contrast.
items.example_sentence_pt: The topstitching adds contrast.
items.professional_context_en: Adds contrast gives students a short effect phrase for captions.
items.professional_context_pt: Adds contrast oferece aos alunos uma frase curta de efeito para captions.

items.definition_en: Creates a light, fun design feeling.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Gives the garment a fun feeling.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Da a roupa uma sensacao divertida.
items.example_sentence_en: The ruffle makes it playful.
items.example_sentence_pt: The ruffle makes it playful.
items.professional_context_en: Makes it playful models a simple style-effect phrase for early critique.
items.professional_context_pt: Makes it playful modela uma frase simples de efeito de estilo para critica inicial.
